text:
kim: @julian customer ACME (tenant: t-acme-987) reports monthly token refill applied for generation but embeddings endpoint still returns 429 (quota_exceeded). UI shows +120k tokens for 'default' project but 'embeddings' shows 0. They upgraded plan last week and have 3 projects — only the root project appears refilled. Repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/chat/completions -> 200 OK; 2) POST /v1/embeddings -> 429. Can we check the refill job logs and per-project ledger?
julian: thanks — paste the tenant and project ids and any curl logs and I'll grep the billing job.
kim: tenant_id: t-acme-987, projects: p-root-12, p-data-34, p-analytics-88. Customer curl (sanitized): ```curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-...\" -H \"X-Project: p-data-34\" -d '{\"model\":\"embed-1\",\"input\":\"test\"}'``` Response: 429 { \"error\":\"quota_exceeded\",\"message\":\"embedding unit tokens exhausted for project\" }
sam: this smells like the refill run populated ledger rows for contract->root project only. We had a mapper change in last deploy that added a join on primary_project — could be skipping secondary subprojects. I'll check the refill batch.
emily: ops-bot shows refill_job ran at 2024-11-01T00:00:05Z and wrote 3 ledger attempts; two were flagged 'skipped: mapping_not_found'. Re-running for t-acme-987 now.
ops-bot: Re-run scheduled: billing.refill_job.run --tenant t-acme-987 --force (ticket 83421) :white_check_mark:
julian: if we re-run, frontend caches may still show 0 for embeddings. Cache key pattern: credit_v2:{tenant}:{project}:embeddings — we should invalidate p-data-34 and p-analytics-88.
emily: flushed caches for p-data-34 and p-analytics-88.
kim: customer on call confirms embeddings calls succeed now (200) and UI shows ~120k for all projects. They asked for a root-cause note and mitigation.
sam: root cause: refill batch used the updated mapping that only returned primary_project after the deploy tweak. Secondary/associated projects were omitted. Fix: update mapper to include associated_projects join and add unit tests for contract->project expansion. PR incoming.
julian: tagging billing eng to backfill any other tenants that might have been impacted and added this to the postmortem checklist.
kim: closing loop with customer, cc @julian @emily @sam. Thanks team :pray:
